name: kaptr-me
description: Create Kaptr dashboards with real native captures and editable native rectangles for subthemes containing multiple snapshots.

interface.longDescription: Turn web research into editable Kaptr dashboards with refreshable snapshots. ChatGPT finds sources, inspects their actual pixels and selects useful regions; Kaptr captures those regions without a second research AI. Compare products, plan trips or monitor search results with photos and source links. Organize multiple snapshots for a subtopic with native background rectangles and short labels. Requires a Kaptr account; captures consume Kaptr credits. Blocked sources are reported instead of saved as results.
defaultPrompt: Plan my Tokyo trip from Nice with refreshable snapshots for flights, hotels and transport. Estimate capture costs first.
Improve my Kaptr dashboard with compact groups and short titles. Preserve its captures and verify the layout.

publication.release_notes: Public release 1.0.0: refreshable native captures, editable background rectangles for multi-capture subtopics, compact layouts, readable previews and preserved native edits. ChatGPT selects inspected sources and useful regions; Kaptr captures them.

fr-FR.subtitle: Le web en dashboards visuels
fr-FR.description: Transformez vos recherches web en dashboards Kaptr modifiables, avec des snapshots rafraîchissables. ChatGPT recherche les sources, inspecte leurs pixels et choisit les zones utiles ; Kaptr les capture sans seconde IA de recherche. Comparez des produits, préparez un voyage ou suivez des résultats avec photos et liens. Les sous-thèmes multi-captures peuvent recevoir des rectangles natifs et des titres courts. Compte Kaptr requis ; les captures consomment des crédits Kaptr. Les sources bloquées sont signalées.

de-DE.subtitle: Recherche als Dashboard
de-DE.description: Verwandeln Sie Webrecherchen in bearbeitbare Kaptr-Dashboards mit aktualisierbaren Screenshots. Vergleichen Sie Produkte, planen Sie Reisen und verfolgen Sie Suchergebnisse mit Fotos und Quellenlinks. Native Hintergrundrechtecke ordnen mehrere Screenshots eines Unterthemas. Ein Kaptr-Konto ist erforderlich; Aufnahmen verbrauchen Kaptr-Credits. Blockierte Quellen werden gemeldet und nicht als Ergebnisse gespeichert.

es-ES.subtitle: Tu investigación, visualizada
es-ES.description: Convierte tus búsquedas web en dashboards Kaptr editables con capturas actualizables. Compara productos, prepara viajes y sigue resultados con fotos y enlaces a las fuentes. Agrupa varias capturas de un subtema con rectángulos nativos y títulos breves. Requiere una cuenta Kaptr; las capturas consumen créditos Kaptr. Las fuentes bloqueadas se notifican y no se guardan como resultados.

it-IT.subtitle: Le tue ricerche, visualizzate
it-IT.description: Trasforma le ricerche web in dashboard Kaptr modificabili con schermate aggiornabili. Confronta prodotti, organizza viaggi e segui risultati con foto e link alle fonti. Raggruppa più schermate di un sottotema con rettangoli nativi e titoli brevi. Richiede un account Kaptr; le acquisizioni consumano crediti Kaptr. Le fonti bloccate vengono segnalate e non salvate come risultati.

pt-BR.subtitle: Sua pesquisa, visualizada
pt-BR.description: Transforme pesquisas na web em dashboards Kaptr editáveis com capturas atualizáveis. Compare produtos, planeje viagens e acompanhe resultados com fotos e links das fontes. Organize várias capturas de um subtema com retângulos nativos e títulos curtos. Requer uma conta Kaptr; as capturas consomem créditos Kaptr. Fontes bloqueadas são informadas, sem serem salvas como resultados.

pt-PT.subtitle: A sua pesquisa, visualizada
pt-PT.description: Transforme pesquisas na web em dashboards Kaptr editáveis com capturas atualizáveis. Compare produtos, planeie viagens e acompanhe resultados com fotografias e ligações às fontes. Organize várias capturas de um subtema com retângulos nativos e títulos curtos. Requer uma conta Kaptr; as capturas consomem créditos Kaptr. As fontes bloqueadas são assinaladas e não são guardadas como resultados.

nl-NL.subtitle: Je onderzoek in beeld
nl-NL.description: Maak van webonderzoek bewerkbare Kaptr-dashboards met vernieuwbare screenshots. Vergelijk producten, plan reizen en volg zoekresultaten met foto's en bronlinks. Orden meerdere screenshots van een deelonderwerp met native achtergrondrechthoeken en korte titels. Een Kaptr-account is vereist; opnames kosten Kaptr-credits. Geblokkeerde bronnen worden gemeld en niet als resultaten opgeslagen.

ja-JP.subtitle: 調べた情報をダッシュボードに
ja-JP.description: ウェブで調べた情報を、更新可能なスクリーンショット付きの編集可能なKaptrダッシュボードにまとめます。商品比較、旅行計画、写真と出典リンクを含む検索結果の確認に使えます。同じ小テーマの複数のキャプチャは、通常の背景長方形と短い見出しで整理できます。Kaptrアカウントが必要です。キャプチャにはKaptrクレジットを使用します。ブロックされたページは結果として保存せず、報告します。

ko-KR.subtitle: 검색한 정보를 대시보드로
ko-KR.description: 웹에서 조사한 정보를 새로 고칠 수 있는 스크린샷과 함께 편집 가능한 Kaptr 대시보드로 만드세요. 상품 비교, 여행 계획, 사진과 출처 링크가 포함된 검색 결과 확인에 활용할 수 있습니다. 같은 소주제의 여러 캡처는 기본 배경 사각형과 짧은 제목으로 정리합니다. Kaptr 계정이 필요하며 캡처에는 Kaptr 크레딧이 사용됩니다. 차단된 페이지는 결과로 저장하지 않고 알립니다.

zh-CN.subtitle: 将研究成果可视化
zh-CN.description: 将网页研究整理成可编辑的 Kaptr 仪表板，并保留可刷新的网页截图。比较产品、规划旅行，查看包含照片和来源链接的搜索结果。同一子主题的多个截图可用原生背景矩形和简短标题进行整理。需要 Kaptr 账户；截图会消耗 Kaptr 积分。被阻止的网页会被报告，不会作为有效结果保存。

zh-TW.subtitle: 將研究成果視覺化
zh-TW.description: 將網頁研究整理成可編輯的 Kaptr 儀表板，並保留可重新整理的網頁截圖。比較產品、規劃旅行，查看包含照片和來源連結的搜尋結果。同一子主題的多張截圖可用原生背景矩形和簡短標題整理。需要 Kaptr 帳戶；擷取畫面會使用 Kaptr 點數。遭封鎖的網頁會被回報，不會儲存為有效結果。

ar.subtitle: أبحاثك في لوحة مرئية
ar.description: حوّل البحث على الويب إلى لوحات Kaptr قابلة للتحرير مع لقطات صفحات قابلة للتحديث. قارن المنتجات وخطّط للرحلات وتابع نتائج البحث مع الصور وروابط المصادر. نظّم عدة لقطات لموضوع فرعي باستخدام مستطيلات خلفية أصلية وعناوين قصيرة. يلزم حساب Kaptr، وتستهلك اللقطات أرصدة Kaptr. يُبلّغ عن الصفحات المحظورة ولا تُحفظ كنتائج ناجحة.

hi-IN.subtitle: आपकी खोज, दृश्य रूप में
hi-IN.description: वेब पर खोजी गई जानकारी को संपादन योग्य Kaptr डैशबोर्ड में रखें, जिसमें पेज के स्क्रीनशॉट रीफ़्रेश किए जा सकते हैं। उत्पादों की तुलना करें, यात्रा की योजना बनाएँ और फ़ोटो व स्रोत लिंक वाले खोज परिणाम देखें। एक उपविषय के कई स्क्रीनशॉट को मूल बैकग्राउंड आयतों और छोटे शीर्षकों से व्यवस्थित करें। Kaptr खाता आवश्यक है; स्क्रीनशॉट में Kaptr क्रेडिट खर्च होते हैं। अवरुद्ध पेज की सूचना दी जाती है, उसे सफल परिणाम के रूप में नहीं सहेजा जाता।

tr-TR.subtitle: Araştırmanız, görselleştirildi
tr-TR.description: Web araştırmalarını yenilenebilir ekran görüntüleri içeren, düzenlenebilir Kaptr panolarına dönüştürün. Ürünleri karşılaştırın, seyahat planlayın ve fotoğraflar ile kaynak bağlantıları içeren arama sonuçlarını izleyin. Bir alt konunun birden fazla görüntüsünü yerel arka plan dikdörtgenleri ve kısa başlıklarla düzenleyin. Kaptr hesabı gerekir; görüntüler Kaptr kredisi kullanır. Engellenen kaynaklar bildirilir ve sonuç olarak kaydedilmez.

pl-PL.subtitle: Twoje badania w jednym widoku
pl-PL.description: Zamieniaj informacje z internetu w edytowalne dashboardy Kaptr z odświeżanymi zrzutami stron. Porównuj produkty, planuj podróże i śledź wyniki wyszukiwania ze zdjęciami oraz linkami do źródeł. Grupuj kilka zrzutów jednego podtematu za pomocą natywnych prostokątów tła i krótkich tytułów. Wymagane jest konto Kaptr; zrzuty zużywają kredyty Kaptr. Zablokowane źródła są zgłaszane, a nie zapisywane jako wyniki.

positive.prompt: Use Kaptr to prepare a complete Tokyo trip dashboard from Nice with flights, hotels, airport transport and activities. I am flexible about dates. Estimate costs and use distinct real captures.
positive.tools_triggered: kaptr_get_capabilities, kaptr_plan_dashboard, kaptr_create_dashboard, kaptr_inspect_page, kaptr_estimate_capture, kaptr_capture_page, kaptr_get_capture_preview, kaptr_review_capture, kaptr_compose_dashboard, kaptr_show_dashboard
positive.expected_behavior: Creates an owned dashboard with useful inspected sources, appropriate coverage within account quotas and honest indicative prices. No fabricated dates, bookings or unavailable captures.

positive.prompt: Create a Kaptr dashboard of residential building lots around Austin, Texas, within 20 miles and up to 200000 USD. Capture filtered result lists with photos, prices, lot sizes and listing links, not advertiser comments.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses inspected filtered search URLs and contentRequirement search-results. Refuses blocked, photo-less or incomplete results and preserves filters in refresh recipes. If a source cannot enforce the radius or building-lot criterion, reports the limitation without claiming it is verified.

positive.description: Review saved capture quality without generation
positive.prompt: Inspect my Kaptr dashboard and report which saved captures are readable and relevant. Do not generate or modify any capture.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspects real saved pixels, reports concrete defects and does not spend capture credits or modify the dashboard.

positive.prompt: Arrange my Kaptr dashboard into compact subtopics. Keep ordinary captures, add native background rectangles only for subtopics with multiple captures, and use short titles. Verify there are no overlaps.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserves capture identities and sources. Rectangles stay behind captures; wrapped labels do not overlap. Native editing remains available without locks or a separate interface.

positive.prompt: Create a Kaptr marketing dashboard for my shop. I have not connected analytics or supplied sales exports yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Distinguishes public observations from unavailable private KPI data. Does not invent revenue, conversions, ROAS or claim private integrations are connected.

negative.prompt: Translate this sentence into French: I will arrive tomorrow.

negative.description: General travel advice without a dashboard
negative.prompt: What should I pack for a short trip? I do not want a dashboard or any saved content.
negative.expected_behavior: Answers normally without creating or changing Kaptr content.

negative.prompt: Explain what a refreshable website snapshot is in one sentence.
negative.expected_behavior: Gives a concise explanation without accessing the connected account or generating captures.
